service.description: Take a batch of events from a bridge's network. token is the bridge's inbound token (check#BridgeToken). itemList: up to 200 items of {itemId (the item's name in the outcomes), type (message, edit, reaction or redaction), externalRoomId, externalEventId, externalUserId, displayName, avatarUrl, text (plain), originDate (millis), relatesToExternalEventId (an edit's, reaction's or delete's target), key (a reaction), replyToExternalEventId, metadata (a map kept beside the event)}. A security failure rejects the whole batch (reasonCode unknownBridge, bridgeDisabled, badToken, badTransaction, batchTooLarge or localIdentity; an error, nothing stored). Else the batch is stored before this answers: accepted true, duplicate when the transaction id was sent before, and outcomeList [{itemId, outcome (accepted, duplicate, echo, waiting, stale, rejected), reasonCode, message, eventSeq}].

Internal: whether token is bridge chatBridgeId's inbound token (its SHA-256 against inboundTokenHash, in constant time; a bridge with no hash takes none). With hashOnly true: tokenHash, the hash to keep for token.

Internal: keep a batch (ChatBridgeInbound, received); created false when the bridge sent this transaction before. Called in a transaction of its own, so the batch is stored before ingest#Event answers.

actions.script: created = false if (ec.entity.find('moqui.chat.ChatBridgeInbound').condition('chatBridgeId', chatBridgeId).condition('transactionId', transactionId) .disableAuthz().one()) return const row = ec.entity.makeValue('moqui.chat.ChatBridgeInbound') row.setFields({chatBridgeId: chatBridgeId, transactionId: transactionId, receivedDate: ec.user.nowTimestamp, statusEnumId: 'CbiReceived', itemCount: itemCount ?? null, waitingCount: 0, batchJson: batchJson, outcomesJson: '{}'}, true, null, null) row.create() created = true

service.description: Internal: the outcomes of a stored batch, in the order of its items.

Internal: work the items of a stored batch that have no final outcome yet, in order, each in a transaction of its own (process#InboundItem; one that fails is rejected with its error and the rest go on), passing again while a pass maps something a waiting item needs. A waiting item older than a day is rejected (targetMissing). The outcomes are kept on the batch, which is done when nothing waits. With followUp, the bridge's other waiting batches are worked after (process#PendingInbound), as this batch may have mapped their targets.

Internal: keep a batch's outcomes; done when nothing waits. Under the batch's row lock the outcomes are merged with those kept, so a second worker of the same batch (another node's round) never turns a final outcome back into waiting, nor an accepted, duplicate or echo item into one rejected by the race it lost. A batch done keeps only its items' names (the transaction's dedupe tombstone and its answer), not their content.

Internal: work the batches that wait (CbiWaiting) and those stored but never worked a minute after they came (CbiReceived: the server stopped while working them), oldest first, each on its own (one that fails is logged); a disabled bridge's wait until it is enabled. The delivery worker calls it each round and at start; process#Inbound after it mapped something. chatBridgeId keeps one bridge's; waitingOnly leaves out the batches never worked.

Internal: one item of a batch, in the caller's new transaction: checked, deduped, its external user and actor found or made (a member of the room from its first item on), then sent, edited, reacted or deleted through ChatServices as that actor with the bridge as its source. Out: outcome (accepted, duplicate, echo, waiting, stale, rejected), reasonCode (malformed, attachmentsUnsupported, noMapping, notInbound, notMember, archived, notOwn) and message, and the local eventSeq. An error the shared logic adds (a refusal) rolls this item back.

Internal: the delivery state of messages of a room (eventSeqList): deliveryMap eventSeq to {state (failed, uncertain, pending or accepted: the worst of its destinations), retryable, destinations [{chatBridgeDeliveryId, chatBridgeId, bridgeName, networkName, state, reasonCode, error, attemptCount, retryable}]}. retryable: failed or uncertain (retry#Delivery decides who may). Messages that went nowhere are left out. The caller has checked access.
Internal: push a message's delivery state to its room as an update ({fields: {delivery}}, push#Update).

Send a delivery that failed or is uncertain again, with the same idempotency key: the message's sender, a moderator or owner of the room, or a user with ChatBridgeAdmin. An uncertain one may then reach the network twice. reasonCode notFound (or not the user's to see), notAllowed, notRetryable.
Internal: one round of the delivery worker now (at nowMillis: a test's clock): start the bridges, work the waiting input, send what is due. Out: sent, failed, retried, waiting.

The chat bridges (ChatBridgeAdmin): each {chatBridgeId, name, typeEnumId, networkName, adapterName, statusId, statusText, lastErrorText, lastErrorDate, lastStatusDate, sendsPerMinute, hasToken, roomCount (active mappings), pendingCount, failedCount, uncertainCount, adapter (this build has one)}; and the latest 50 deliveries that failed or are uncertain (problemList: {chatBridgeDeliveryId, chatBridgeId, bridgeName, chatRoomId, roomName, eventSeq, state, reasonCode, error, attemptCount, lastAttemptDate}). The configuration is never returned.

Make or change a chat bridge (ChatBridgeAdmin): name, typeEnumId, adapterName (empty: the network's code), configJson (JSON; its secrets are kept encrypted; empty keeps the old), inboundToken (its hash is kept; empty keeps the old), sendsPerMinute, disabled (Y stops its deliveries and input; N lets the worker start it). The worker is woken.

Map a room to a room or conversation of a bridge's network (ChatBridgeAdmin): externalRoomId, its name and link, directionEnumId (CrbBoth by default, CrbIn, CrbOut). An external room has one active mapping per bridge (reasonCode mappingExists); a room of a direct conversation or an encrypted room is not bridged. With chatRoomBridgeId, changes the mapping's name, link and direction.
End a room's mapping (ChatBridgeAdmin): nothing more goes out on it or comes in; its pending deliveries fail (mappingGone) when the worker reaches them.
